official_name: Single (Unique) residence permit for digital mobile workers, Law No. 79/2021 On Aliens, Article 68
status_note: Statute (Ministry of Interior English text of Law 79/2021) provides the permit; the e-Albania service page could not be read (404), so current operational status is not confirmed on the portal
min_income_basis: Applicant must prove 'sufficient income to provide for himself/herself and his/her dependants'; no amount stated in the law (Art. 68(b))
fee_text: State fee is set by Council of Ministers' Decision (Art. 140); amount not read
processing_time: Single residence permit is issued within 4 to 12 weeks from the date of application when requirements are met (Art. 56(4))
notes: Art. 68 conditions: employment/service contract with employer or client based abroad and no physical headquarters; proof of sufficient income; proof of accommodation and Albanian home address; one-year health insurance; criminal record certificate. Art. 77: issued without labour-market test. Definition of mobile digital workers in Art. 3 pt 39. Statute read from PDF text (English translation on mb.gov.al).

official_name: Nomad Digital Residence (NDR) Programme
status_note: Government notice dated 2025-11-10 says programme discontinued on 2025-11-15
min_income_basis: not verified (programme closed; official page 503)
notes: Closure confirmed on the official notices page (notice dated 2025-11-10, discontinued 2025-11-15). The linked PDF returned 404 on two fetches (curl and WebFetch); a search excerpt of that PDF (seen via search excerpt of official page) says the NDR programme ends on 15 November 2025. Notice text does not say what happens to existing holders or pending applications.

official_name: Residencia transitoria como Nómada Digital
status_note: Official service page live
min_income_basis: No fixed minimum; proof of remote activity via contract, endorsement or income receipts (translated)
fee_text: Initial application for non-MERCOSUR nationals 32 UMSM (MERCOSUR 16 UMSM); extension 40 UMSM (MERCOSUR 20 UMSM); fee table states 1 UMSM = $1000 (table under Decree 584/2024, undated on page) (translated)
processing_time: Not stated; electronic entry authorisation (TIE 24H) notified by email (translated)
notes: Legal basis Disposicion DNM 758/2022 (Art. 24 h Law 25.871) per fetched norm page; norm text and service pages state no minimum income, no dependants provision, no insurance requirement, no tax provision.

official_name: One Happy Workation
status_note: Tourism authority page says programme available; it is not a visa
min_income_basis: No income requirement stated; must be employed or self-employed in home country
fee_text: Programme has no fee; guests buy discounted accommodation packages
tax_treatment: Not registered as an Aruba resident; income is supplied by a company in the home country, so no Aruba tax obligation is stated (page answer: 'No')
notes: US nationals with valid passport only. A tourism programme within visitor-stay rules, not a permit. Visitors may not work for Aruban companies/individuals.

official_name: Bahamas Extended Access Travel Stay (BEATS)
status_note: BEATS site directs to immigration portal; no closure seen
min_income_basis: No income threshold in FAQ fetched
fee_text: US$25 application + US$1,000 permit per professional applicant; dependants US$25 + US$500 each
processing_time: Estimated five days
notes: Also covers students (US$525). Fee currency stated as USD on FAQ. Ministry press release PDF on immigration.gov.bs was unreadable.

official_name: 12-Month Barbados Welcome Stamp
status_note: Tourism authority page invites applications
min_income_basis: Annual income over the 12 months of the stamp
fee_text: USD 2,000 individual; USD 3,000 family bundle; non-refundable
processing_time: Typically approved within 7 business days
tax_treatment: Not liable for Barbados income tax; 17.5% VAT on purchases
notes: Remote work for non-Barbados employers/clients only. Source is Visit Barbados (state tourism agency).

official_name: Work Where You Vacation
status_note: Belize Tourism Board page (official tourism authority) states the programme is actively accepting applications via the Immigration Department; immigration.gov.bz pages checked (home, permits, visa types, long-stay) do not mention it
min_income_basis: Individuals; USD 100,000 for couples/families
fee_text: BZD 500 per adult, BZD 200 per child under 18
notes: Tax and processing time not stated; no closure notice on the page.

official_name: One Year Residential Certificate (Work From Bermuda)
status_note: Government online service and apply form listed
min_income_basis: Sufficient means/continuous income without gainful employment in Bermuda; no amount stated
fee_text: $263 (currency symbol only as stated)
processing_time: Process described as swift; no time given
notes: Policy dated 2020; also open to non-Bermudian post-secondary students. Cannot seek employment in Bermuda.

official_name: Visto Temporário XIV - Nômade Digital (VITEM XIV)
status_note: Open. MRE consulate pages (translated) state e-visa issuance of temporary visas for nationals exempt from visitor visas from 1 September 2026 via the Integrated Consular System (SCI); only search excerpts of gov.br/mre pages could be read (captcha/rate-limit on direct fetch); re-verify in a browser.
min_income_basis: Foreign-source monthly means, as stated (translated)
fee_text: No single figure: consular fee varies by consulate and nationality; EUR 100 for most nationalities (Helsinki embassy page) and for EU and North Macedonian citizens (Sofia embassy page), EUR 100 at Lisbon (all read in a browser by the audit; a 110 figure in an earlier version was wrong); paid at the consulate after the SCI application is submitted (seen via search excerpt of official page)
processing_time: Up to 5 business days (translated) (seen via search excerpt of official page)
notes: Income USD 1,500/month or USD 18,000 bank funds re-confirmed by search excerpts of consulate pages (translated). Dependants, tax and the governing Portaria/Normative Resolution text not verified from any readable official page; excerpt cites Portaria 428 (unread).

official_name: Digital nomad long-term residence permit (Law on Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria, new Art. 24c)
status_note: Statute confirmed: State Gazette no. 52 of 27 Jun 2025 adds digital nomads (Art. 24 para 1 item 23; conditions in new Art. 24s) to the Law on Foreigners. Fees, processing time and insurance come from the general long-term residence service page, which does not mention digital nomads; implementing rules and D-visa steps not confirmed (mfa.bg blocked)
min_income_basis: COMPUTED. Art. 24c requires an average annual income of not less than 50 minimum monthly wages for the previous calendar year (dv.parliament.bg, translated). Formula: 50 x BGN 1,077 = BGN 53,850, where BGN 1,077 is the minimum monthly wage from 1 Jan 2025 (Council of Ministers Decree No. 359/23.10.2024, per Ministry of Economy page https://www.mi.government.bg/en/general/vaznagrajdeniya-i-osigurovki/). Applies to applications made in 2026 (previous calendar year = 2025); the 2026 wage is higher (BGN 1,213 per a search result on Decree No. 243/13.11.2025, not read directly), so the figure rises yearly. The statute itself states no amount
fee_text: Generic long-term residence service page (not nomad-specific; it does not mention digital nomads) lists (translated): application fee 10 BGN; residence permit up to 6 months 200 BGN, up to 1 year 500 BGN; currency as stated on the page, which may pre-date the euro changeover
processing_time: [general long-term residence service, not nomad-specific] Up to 120 days from application submission (standard 14-60 days, extendable by up to two months) (translated)
notes: Three categories (translated): employee of an employer registered outside the EU/EEA providing remote services by IT; owner/shareholder over 25% of such company; freelancer providing remote services for at least one year. Register page cites Art. 24(1) item 22, State Gazette text cites item 23; discrepancy unresolved. Also required: housing, criminal record, means of support. A type D visa is a prior step; BTA (state news agency) reported it is valid up to six months with stay up to 180 days; not read on mfa.bg.

official_name: Nómadas Digitais (Digital Nomads) - e-Residencia
status_note: Page lists requirements and fee; online application marked 'coming soon' (translated)
min_income_basis: Proof of income required; no amount stated
fee_text: Listed as 5000 CVE (translated)
notes: Requirements (translated): passport, criminal record certificate, proof of link to remote employer, proof of income, accommodation, medical certificate.

official_name: Global Citizen Certificate (Global Citizen Concierge Programme)
status_note: Audit 2026-09-29: regulations provided for an application deadline of 31 Oct 2022 and expiry on 30 Nov 2024 unless extended by Cabinet; secondary reports say the regulations lapsed and the programme is reported closed. No official extension read. Fees and thresholds are historical
min_income_basis: Continuous annual income from outside the Islands, minimum USD 100,000 for applicant alone; USD 150,000 with one dependant; 168,000 with two; 186,000 with three; 204,000 with four; 222,000 with five; discretion of Director of WORC beyond five
fee_text: Annual fee $1230 for applicant and one dependant; $420 annual fee for each further dependant; second year fee payable by end of first year (currency symbol only as stated)
notes: Read from Immigration (Transition) (Global Citizen Exemption) Regulations (2023 Revision), consolidated as at 31 Dec 2022. Applicant must be employed outside the Islands and may not offer goods or services to anyone in the Islands. A gov.ky press release titled 'Global Citizen Concierge Programme extended' appeared in search results but returned 404 on fetch, so no extension is confirmed.

official_name: Visitante - Nómada digital (Visa V)
status_note: Fee page and Resolution 5477/2022 (Art. 46) list the visa; no closure notice seen
min_income_basis: 3 SMMLV shown by bank statements for the last 3 months (Res. 5477/2022 Art. 46, translated); SMMLV 2026 fixed at COP 1,750,905 per month by Decree 159/2026 (translated)
fee_text: Visa fee USD 183 (EUR 141) plus study fee USD 56 (EUR 44) per fee page
tax_treatment: General rule, no nomad regime found: DIAN page states tax residency arises from more than 183 calendar days in any 365 consecutive days; page does not mention digital nomads (translated)
notes: Savings alternative: none stated in Art. 46. Processing time not stated on pages read.

official_name: Digital Nomads / remote workers and international-service providers (Law 10.008)
status_note: Application requirements page live (Costa Rica Tourism Board, official); migracion.go.cr blocked (403)
min_income_basis: Monthly income from outside Costa Rica; USD 4,000 if applying with dependants
fee_text: USD 100 government fee, or colón equivalent
tax_treatment: Tourism board page states digital nomads are exempt from income tax (as stated; not read on immigration or statute page)
notes: Conflict: main tourism page promotional text says USD 5,000 for families, while the requirements page says USD 4,000 with dependants; requirements page kept. migracion.go.cr still returns 403.

official_name: Temporary stay of digital nomads
status_note: Ministry of Interior page describes application process, checked 2026-09-28
min_income_basis: At least 2.5 average monthly net salaries paid in the previous year; currently 3,622.50 EUR per month (increases by 10% of the average salary per family member)
fee_text: 46.45 EUR at police (plus card fees 9.29 and 31.85 EUR); at a consulate 55.74 EUR plus 93.00 EUR for D visa or 41.14 EUR for card
tax_treatment: Tax Administration page on tax changes from 1 Jan 2021 states that the tax position of income earned by digital nomads was defined as an exemption from taxation (translated); eligibility conditions are not detailed on that page
notes: Must work for a foreign employer or own foreign company and not for Croatian employers; new application possible 6 months after prior stay expires; documents in Croatian or English.

official_name: @HOME in Curaçao (remote worker / digital nomad temporary stay permit)
status_note: FAQ states applications are open
min_income_basis: No income threshold stated on FAQ; must prove location-independent work
fee_text: ANG 535 per applicant (remote workers)
processing_time: About 2 weeks
tax_treatment: Remote workers are not required to pay Curaçao income tax
notes: All nationalities. Same programme has hibernator and investor categories (not recorded). Government ownership now supported by the Curacao Tourist Board article (says the government of Curacao introduced the programme). That older article quotes an application fee of $294, which differs from the ANG 535 on the FAQ; FAQ figure kept as the current one, unresolved.

official_name: Cyprus Digital Nomad Visa Scheme
status_note: Read on the official gov.cy Migration Department page 'Digital nomads and family members' (posted 31 December 2025): applications are being accepted again, cap remains 500 permits. Verified in audit 2026-09-29 (page loads with a browser user agent).
min_income_basis: Stable and sufficient monthly net income of at least EUR 3,500 after deduction of contributions and taxes
tax_treatment: The official page states: staying one or more periods totalling more than 183 days in the same tax year makes the person a Cyprus tax resident, provided not tax resident in another country. No scheme-specific tax break stated
notes: Search-result excerpt of the gov.cy page mentioned a net income of at least 3,500 EUR/month and 1 year plus 2-year renewal; not confirmed from the page, so not entered as data.

official_name: Digital Nomad Program (Ministry of Industry and Trade fast-track)
status_note: Consular page updated 13.03.2026 describes the programme; no legal entitlement to participation
min_income_basis: Income threshold not stated on the consular page
fee_text: General long-term (national, type D) visa fee per the Czech MFA fee schedule; the programme page does not state a fee and some nationalities are exempt or reduced
processing_time: Applications processed within 45 days of submission
notes: Only highly qualified IT or marketing employees of foreign employers, or freelancers with a Czech trade licence in IT/marketing. Separate general zivno (business) visa not verified.

official_name: Work In Nature (WIN) Extended Stay Visa
status_note: Official WIN site presents online application and fee pages as live
min_income_basis: expected income of US$50,000 or more over next 12 months, and/or means to support self and accompanying family
fee_text: Non-refundable application fee US$100; then visa fee US$800 single applicant, US$1,200 family; business team of 4+: US$800 plus US$500 per additional employee
processing_time: Approval letter within 14-28 days of submitting the form; 30 days after approval to pay visa fee
tax_treatment: No income tax liable in Dominica; waiver on income tax granted to persons working remotely from Dominica under the WIN Visa; applicants remain responsible for taxes in their home country
notes: Minimum age 18. Business teams also eligible. Fee page did not list a separate couple price.

official_name: Visa de residencia temporal rentista para trabajo remoto (Visa Nómada)
status_note: Official procedure page live
min_income_basis: 3 SBU per month from foreign sources shown by statements of the previous 3 months (translated); SBU 2026 = USD 482 per Ministerio del Trabajo (translated)
fee_text: Application USD 50 plus visa issuance USD 270, total USD 320; no IVA; 50% discount aged 65+; exemption for 30%+ disability (translated). Re-read 2026-09-29: page still states 50+270; no USD 460 figure found on any official page
notes: Fee conflict resolved in favour of USD 320 (official gob.ec procedure page read twice); USD 460 excerpt not reproduced. Processing time not stated on the page.

official_name: Digital Nomad Visa (Type D long-stay visa, teleworking)
status_note: Work in Estonia (state agency) page presents applications as open, with restrictions for Russia and Belarus
min_income_basis: Subsistence funds for teleworking (digital nomad visa) stated as 132 EUR per day (3,960 EUR per month) on the MFA long-stay visa page
fee_text: Visa fee EUR 120; children 6-11 EUR 60; some exemptions
processing_time: Processing usually takes up to 30 days
tax_treatment: Tax Board: a person staying in Estonia at least 183 days within 12 consecutive calendar months is a tax resident (worldwide income); non-residents pay income tax only on income received in Estonia. The state e-Residency FAQ (https://www.e-resident.gov.ee/blog/posts/faqs-about-estonias-digital-nomad-visa/) applies the 183-day rule to digital nomad visa holders
notes: Teleworking documents include employer confirmation or contracts and tax/social-contribution proof from applicant's country; income proof for previous 3 months. The 3,960/month figure is the teleworking row of the MFA subsistence table (not labelled as an income threshold).

official_name: Remotely from Georgia (state programme) and visa-free one-year stay
status_note: Audit 2026-09-29: the tourism administration text describes 'Remotely from Georgia' in the past tense (pandemic-era) and the SDA page lists no nomad permit. What exists is the visa-free one-year stay for citizens of 98 countries and a 20% / 1% tax split. Not a nomad permit, so listed as no scheme
fee_text: No fee stated on pages read
tax_treatment: Tourism administration states employees are taxed at 20% and self-employed/individual entrepreneurs at 1% of taxes (page wording; no Revenue Service source read)
notes: State Services Development Agency (sda.gov.ge) page read lists an IT residence permit (2 years' IT experience, USD 25,000 annual income) and no dedicated remote-work permit. Revenue Service small-business page was JavaScript-only and unreadable.

official_name: Residence permit for freelance work (Section 21(5) Residence Act); no nomad-specific scheme found
status_note: No digital-nomad-specific permit named on the Federal Foreign Office and BAMF pages checked; freelance permit is the closest route
min_income_basis: No fixed amount; applicant must show means to fund the project and support themselves
fee_text: Berlin foreigners authority (LEA) lists EUR 100.00 for a residence permit issued as electronic residence permit (EUR 56.00 as sticker label); fee is for in-country issue, local schedule; also see AufenthV s.45 (gesetze-im-internet.de) which sets 100 EUR for permits valid over one year. Visa fee at a mission not read
processing_time: Berlin LEA: sticker permit can be issued on the spot at the appointment; electronic residence permit takes 4-6 weeks before collection (translated from German). Excludes visa stage at mission
notes: Freelancers in liberal professions need permission to practise; over-45s must show old-age provision. Absence of a nomad scheme is inferred, not stated by the pages.

official_name: Digital Nomad Visa (national D-type visa), Ministry of Foreign Affairs
status_note: Audit 2026-09-29: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs page 'Digital Nomad Visa' (read in a real browser) states no figures and refers readers to workfromgreece.gr. The scheme itself (national D visa, Law 4825/2021 art. 11) is confirmed by EY Greece (15 Sept 2021) and taxheaven.gr (25 Aug 2021), both summarising the law
min_income_basis: EUR 3,500 a month stable income, after tax (workfromgreece.gr; EY Greece; taxheaven.gr summarising Law 4825/2021 art. 11). The mfa.gr page itself gives no figure
fee_text: National visa fee EUR 75 (Law 4825/2021 art. 11 text as reproduced on e-forologia.gr; also EUR 75 per taxheaven.gr and workfromgreece.gr). Residence permit application fee EUR 1,000 per the same law text. EUR 150 per family member and the EUR 16 card-printing fee come from secondary pages only (workfromgreece.gr; search excerpt of a Greek law-firm page)
processing_time: [secondary] Consulate confirms receipt within 10 days, approval typically within one month (workfromgreece.gr)
tax_treatment: Not stated for the visa itself. The 50% income-tax reduction for new residents (Art. 5C, Income Tax Code) requires transferring tax residence and is aimed at income from activity in Greece; it is not automatic for visa holders who work only for foreign employers. Not confirmed on an official page; get written advice
notes: Audit 2026-09-29 (browser read of mfa.gr): the mfa.gr digital nomad page contains only a pointer to workfromgreece.gr; earlier 'official' figures were misattributed to it. Figures now sourced to the law summaries and workfromgreece.gr. Primary law text (Law 4825/2021 art. 11, ministry circular) not readable as text in this audit; confirm at consulate. 50% tax break not confirmed and likely not automatic.

official_name: Remote-work permit under the Remote Employment Act, 2021
status_note: Act No. 3 of 2021 (in force from 9 July 2021) published on the Grenada Parliament site; no page seen on this check confirms the permit is currently being issued or how to apply
min_income_basis: Proof of an actual annual income of not less than EC$100,000.00 generated outside Grenada, intended to continue for the permit period
fee_text: Schedule II: application fee US$1,500/EC$4,050 individual; US$2,000/EC$5,400 individual plus up to 3 dependants; US$200/EC$540 per additional dependant; renewal US$1,400/EC$3,780 individual, US$1,900/EC$5,130 with up to 3 dependants
tax_treatment: No income tax payable on income generated outside Grenada in accordance with the Act; permit holder deemed non-resident for voting, citizenship and immigration purposes
notes: Statute text read on Grenada Parliament site. The Grenada Tourism Authority article (dated 2021-06-01) repeats the terms. Permit holders may not work for or offer services to businesses or persons in Grenada.

official_name: White Card - residency for digital nomads
status_note: Immigration authority factsheet describes the application procedure
min_income_basis: Monthly legal income of at least 3,000 EUR net for at least 6 months before entry and throughout the stay
fee_text: White Card factsheet refers to the procedural-fees page without giving an amount, and the White Card is not listed separately there. Residence-permit fees on that page: EUR 110 at a consulate (permit plus entry visa); HUF 39,000 if applied in person in Hungary; HUF 26,000 via Enter Hungary; HUF 26,000 to extend. Amount shown is the consulate figure and assumes the general residence-permit fee applies (not stated explicitly for White Card)
processing_time: Procedural time 21 days; decision within 30 days of submission
tax_treatment: No White Card specific tax rule stated on the OIF factsheet. The tax authority NAV states that Hungarian-resident private persons are taxed on all income, whether earned in Hungary or abroad, at a personal income tax rate of 15%; the tax liability of foreign nationals is limited to Hungarian-source income. Which status a White Card holder has depends on tax residency, which was not tested on the pages read
notes: Permit withdrawn if working for a Hungarian employer or acquiring a Hungarian company share; no other permit for other purposes during/after validity.

official_name: E33G Visa Rumah Kedua Pekerja Jarak Jauh (Remote Worker Second Home Visa)
status_note: Official imigrasi.go.id visa page lists E33G with fees and requirements
min_income_basis: Bank record showing salary/income of at least US$60,000 per year (translated)
fee_text: Rp7,000,000 for a 1-year stay; components listed: limited-stay visa Rp500,000, category II verification Rp2,000,000, limited stay permit Rp3,000,000, re-entry permit Rp1,500,000 (translated)
processing_time: Five working days after visa payment is received (translated)
notes: Also requires an employment agreement with a company established outside Indonesia and proof of living funds: 3 months bank statements with at least USD 2,000 (translated). Passport valid 6+ months.

official_name: Digital Nomad / Remote Worker visa (national visa)
status_note: Consulate General of Italy in New York page lists the visa with an appointment process; page text refers to 2024 figures, check current amounts
min_income_basis: The governing decree (Ministry of the Interior decree of 29 Feb 2024, Gazzetta Ufficiale n. 79 of 4 Apr 2024) sets a formula, not an amount: lawful annual income of not less than three times the minimum level for exemption from healthcare cost participation. The lowest national exemption level is EUR 8,263.31 (Sistema Tessera Sanitaria, sistemats1.sanita.finanze.it), so the formula gives EUR 24,789.93, rounded to 24,790 (COMPUTED). Consulate sheets print different figures: New York 24,789 (2024), Valletta 25,500 (3 x 8,500), Tunis embassy sheet of 25 May 2026 'approximately 27,000'. The 27,000 is an unexplained approximation, so ask the competent consulate which figure it applies. Tunis sheet: https://ambtunisi.esteri.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/scheda_informativa_visto_lavoro_nomadi_digitali-ENG-FRA.pdf
fee_text: Consulate General in Paris page (translated): 116 euros, cash. The fee is consulate-specific and adjusts quarterly with the exchange rate (New York page: posted on its own fees page, in USD)
processing_time: Varies by consulate: Embassy in Valletta says up to 90 days for remote workers and up to 120 days for digital nomads; Paris consulate (https://consparigi.esteri.it/it/servizi-consolari-e-visti/servizi-per-il-cittadino-straniero/visti/visto-per-nomadi-digitali-e-lavoratori-da-remoto/) says up to 30 days for remote workers and up to 120 days for digital nomads
tax_treatment: No nomad-specific tax rule on the consulate pages read. The Agenzia delle Entrate page on the impatriati regime (art. 5 D.Lgs. 209/2023, from tax year 2024, translated) taxes 50% of qualifying income up to EUR 600,000 a year, for the year of transfer plus four years, but requires a commitment to Italian tax residence for at least 4 years, no Italian residence in the previous 3 tax periods, work performed mostly in Italy and high-level qualification requirements; not shown to apply automatically to visa holders
notes: Only for highly skilled workers (art. 27-quater), 6+ months prior work experience, signed lease in applicant's name for whole visa duration. Remote workers need contract with salary at least ISTAT median. Income threshold conflict: New York, Los Angeles and Boston consulates state 24,789 EUR/year (as of 2024); the Embassy in Valletta page (undated) states triple of 8,500 EUR (i.e. 25,500 EUR); Paris page gives no figure. Left at 24,789; confirm with the competent consulate.

official_name: Specified visa: Designated Activities (Digital Nomad, Spouse or Child of Digital Nomad)
status_note: MOFA page and Japanese embassy checklists listed in search results; direct fetch blocked (403), details from search summaries
min_income_basis: Annual income of at least 10 million yen at time of application
tax_treatment: Immigration Services Agency Q&A (as of July 2024): remuneration for activities in Japan is exempt from Japanese tax only if the tax convention requirements are met (in most cases stay of 183 days or less in the taxable year or any consecutive 12 months, and pay not from a Japanese-resident employer); otherwise not exempt. No residence card is issued
notes: Only for nationals of a designated list of countries/regions. Not verified directly: page returned 403.

official_name: Neo Nomad Visa (B12-1)
status_note: Kazakh MFA embassy page (Feb 2025) describes the visa; current status not re-verified
min_income_basis: Bank statement for the past six months confirming a stable monthly income of at least USD 3,000
fee_text: [secondary] Consular fee of 30 MRP (117,960 KZT in 2025) per DOS Immigration, a private immigration-services site; not stated in the official instruction PDF read
processing_time: Visa issued within five working days upon submission (Kazakhstan MFA instruction document)
notes: Page dated 7 Feb 2025. Also lists Digital Nomad Visa B9-1 for IT professionals seeking permanent residence via Astana Hub petition (not a remote-work permit).

official_name: Permit Class N: Digital Nomads (KEP/N)
status_note: Published on the official eFNS infopack; applications via eFNS portal
min_income_basis: 3 months of bank statements/payslips proving monthly income; no minimum amount stated
fee_text: Processing US$200 (non-refundable); issuance US$1,000 per year
notes: For those working remotely for a foreign-registered company (employee, shareholder/representative, or self-employed with overseas clients). Requires home-country embassy no-objection letter, accommodation proof, cover letters, Form 25.

official_name: Long-stay visa for remote work
status_note: PMLP page updated 11.02.2026 describes the visa
min_income_basis: Not less than 2.5 times the previous year's average monthly gross salary (4,213 EUR on the page)
fee_text: PMLP state fee for a national long-stay (D) visa is EUR 90; EUR 180 for expedited submission (less than three working days before the legal deadline). The fee page does not mention remote work specifically; the remote-work page says a state fee payment document is required
notes: Employer or own business must be registered in an OECD member state; at least 6 months prior employment/self-employment; holders may not work in Latvia.

official_name: DE Rantau Nomad Pass (Professional Visit Pass)
status_note: MDEC FAQ v10.0 dated 28 Aug 2026 describes applications as open
min_income_basis: Tech talent/profession at least USD 24,000/year; non-tech talent at least USD 60,000/year
fee_text: MDEC processing fee RM1,080 per applicant and RM540 per dependant (incl. 8% SST), non-refundable; separate immigration pass fee RM90 per 3 months or RM360 per year; refundable bond RM200-RM2,000 by nationality if MDEC sponsors
processing_time: 6 to 8 weeks after complete submission; e-Pass issued within 1 week of endorsement application
tax_treatment: Foreign freelancers: income from outside Malaysia taxed under s4(a) ITA 1967 subject to s7; withholding 10% (or DTA rate) for first 182 days, taxable as resident after 182 days; LHDN tax e-registration slip required
notes: Open to all nationalities except Israel; main holder 18+. Valid only in Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan. Passport validity over 14 months at application. Employer must be non-Malaysian; contract 3+ months old. Tourist-pass conversion not allowed.

official_name: Nomad Residence Permit
status_note: Residency Malta Agency pages describe new applications and renewals; income threshold 42,000 EUR re-confirmed 2026-09-29
min_income_basis: Minimum gross yearly income 42,000 EUR (32,400 EUR for applications submitted before 1 April 2024)
fee_text: Verified 2026-09-29 on Residency Malta Agency: EUR 300 non-refundable application fee per person (bank transfer) plus EUR 100 residency card issuance fee per person (in person); additional visa fees if applicable. A search excerpt of the same page also lists an EUR 50 card administration fee, not seen in the fetched text
processing_time: Verified 2026-09-29: 30 working days from the date of the receipt issued by the Finance Department for the funds; after approval in principle, proof of accommodation and health insurance within 30 working days; residence card 3 to 4 weeks after that
tax_treatment: Refers to S.L. 123.210 Nomad Residence Permits (Income Tax) Rules and Income Tax Acts; no summary rate given
notes: Third-country nationals only; must work for foreign employer/company or foreign clients; income guaranteed for at least 5 months from application; 5 months cumulative residence in Malta needed for renewal; rental or purchase agreement of at least 12 months.

official_name: Premium Visa
status_note: Official EDB/Passport and Immigration Office pages describe the visa as current
min_income_basis: Evidence of funds: 3 months bank statements plus proof of monthly income; minimum USD 1500 per month for each adult applicant and USD 500 per month for each dependent child
fee_text: Issued free of charge; no processing fee
tax_treatment: Income earned in Mauritius taxed on a remittance basis; money spent with foreign cards not deemed remitted
notes: Open to tourists, retirees and remote-working professionals. Separate USD 50 fee from 1 Dec 2025 applies to Occupation Permit / Retired Residence Permit, not Premium Visa. The USD 1500 figure is from an EDB FAQ PDF (uploaded 2023/12, COVID-era wording); the residency.mu page does not state an amount; re-verify.

official_name: Visa de residencia temporal (por solvencia economica; general route, not a nomad visa)
status_note: General temporary-resident route via Mexican consulates, not a dedicated digital-nomad visa; SRE page allows work only if salary is paid abroad (translated). Thresholds vary by consulate and year; Las Vegas consulate 2026 sheet used.
min_income_basis: Bank statements with monthly income above USD 4,630 over the last six months plus employment/pension or self-employment proof; Las Vegas consulate 2026 sheet, amounts differ by consulate (translated)
fee_text: Visa fee USD 56 at Las Vegas consulate; other fees per Ley Federal de Derechos (translated)
processing_time: 1 to 10 business days from the appointment day, Las Vegas consulate (translated)
notes: Tax and health insurance not stated on pages read. No Mexican official page offers a nomad-specific visa.

official_name: Right of residence for the purpose of digital nomadism (Law No. 200/2010 on the regime of foreigners)
status_note: General Inspectorate for Migration publishes an application form and document list for granting/extending residence for digital nomadism; Invest Moldova page (content updated July 2024 per page) describes the programme
min_income_basis: At least 18 times the average salary forecast for the current year in Moldova (three salaries per month), shown over the last 6 months; MDL figure not stated on pages read
fee_text: Invest Moldova lists a fee for examining the application and a fee for issuing the permit; no amounts stated
processing_time: Not stated on the pages read (a 90-day examination period, extendable by 60 days, was quoted from a search excerpt of the IGM page and could not be confirmed on the page)
notes: Documents: application, ID, housing proof, criminal record (apostilled, translated), medical insurance, 6 months bank statements, foreign entity solvency document, employment/service contract, sworn statement of remote work. Government approved the draft law on 2025-04-29 (consecon.gov.md, Economic Council). Extension applications due 30 calendar days before expiry (15 for EU citizens).

official_name: Digital nomad temporary residence permit (Programme for attracting digital nomads)
status_note: digitalnomads.gov.me (read 2026-09-29) shows an 'Apply now' call and the legal-status article describes the permit; programme text refers to a period until 2025 (gov.me article of 28 Dec 2021); no closure statement found. Keep re-check.
min_income_basis: Only 'proof of financial means of support' stated, no amount found on page
processing_time: Within 40 days of a proper application
notes: Must show work for a foreign company or own company not registered in Montenegro; accommodation proof; clean criminal record (offences over 6 months); biometrics. Page cites average monthly costs of 800-1500 EUR (not a requirement).

official_name: Montserrat Remote Workers Stamp
status_note: Programme site shows Apply Now; Tourism Authority guide describes it as current
min_income_basis: minimum annual income of USD$70,000, as stated
fee_text: USD 500 single; USD 750 with up to 3 family members; USD 250 each additional; non-refundable
processing_time: Decision within 7 days/working days of submission
tax_treatment: Applicants will not be liable to pay Montserrat income tax
notes: Must be employed by foreign employer, own foreign company, or freelance mainly for foreign clients. Police record required. The gov.ms 2021 notice does not state an income threshold; the USD 70,000 figure (EC$189,000) comes from the programme site montserratremoteworker.com/the-stamp, which agrees with the tourism guide. gov.ms notice is dated 2021-01-29 and may be out of date.

official_name: Visa de Corta Estancia como Trabajador Remoto
status_note: Open: Panama investment-promotion agency PROPANAMA (official) page describes the visa under Executive Decree 198 of 7 May 2021 (translated); page is undated and the Migracion requirements PDF is currently a 404 or unreadable, so re-verify
min_income_basis: Minimum annual earnings B/.36,000 from foreign sources; monthly payments above USD 3,000 for employed workers (translated)
fee_text: USD 250 payment to the Servicio Nacional de Migracion (translated)
notes: Dependants and tax not stated on the page read. Legal basis Executive Decree 198 of 2021 (Gaceta Oficial 29290-A) cited by PROPANAMA and search excerpts; gazette PDF could not be read.

official_name: Digital Nomad Visa (Executive Order No. 86, s. 2025)
status_note: EO signed 24 Apr 2025 authorising DFA to issue DNVs; implementing rules/launch not verified
min_income_basis: EO requires sufficient income generated outside the Philippines; no amount verified
notes: EO read via search summary (direct fetch 403). Requires 18+, clean record, nationality of a country offering DNVs to Filipinos with a Philippine post, no Philippine employment.

official_name: Residency visa for a professional activity done remotely - "digital nomads"
status_note: Listed as a current visa category on the official visa portal and on the AIMA page for Art. 88 no. 1 (Nomadas Digitais), checked 2026-09-29
min_income_basis: Visa page: proof of average monthly income over the last three months of at least four times the monthly minimum guaranteed remuneration (RMMG). Computed 4 x 920 EUR = 3,680 EUR, where 920 EUR is the RMMG for 2026 (Decreto-Lei 139/2025, in force 1 Jan 2026) per DGERT page https://www.dgert.gov.pt/retribuicao-minima-mensal-garantida-para-2026; the visa page itself states only the multiple. Mainland rate; Azores and Madeira RMMG differ.
fee_text: Fee for processing a national visa application is 110 EUR
processing_time: Decision deadline for a residency visa application is 60 days
tax_treatment: The visa and AIMA pages read state no tax regime for D8 holders. The Tax Authority (AT) page on IFICI, the successor to NHR (art. 58-A Tax Benefits Statute), describes a 20% rate on category A/B income from listed qualifying activities (higher-education teaching and research, qualified posts, highly qualified professions, R&D, startups) for 10 years, for people not tax resident in Portugal in the prior 5 years and not previous NHR beneficiaries (translated). Remote work for a foreign employer is not listed as a qualifying activity on the page read, so no automatic tax break for D8 holders is shown; general IRS residence rules apply
notes: Requires work contract/declaration of employer (employees) or society contract/service contract (independent), proof of fiscal residence, and income proof. Tax page-level statement absent.

official_name: Temporary stay visa for the exercise of a professional activity done remotely - "digital nomads"
status_note: Listed as a current visa category on the official visa portal, checked 2026-09-29
min_income_basis: Visa page: proof of average monthly income over the last three months of at least four times the monthly minimum guaranteed remuneration (RMMG). Computed 4 x 920 EUR = 3,680 EUR, where 920 EUR is the RMMG for 2026 (Decreto-Lei 139/2025, in force 1 Jan 2026) per DGERT page https://www.dgert.gov.pt/retribuicao-minima-mensal-garantida-para-2026; the visa page itself states only the multiple. Mainland rate; Azores and Madeira RMMG differ.
fee_text: Fee for processing a national visa application is 110 EUR
processing_time: Decision deadline for a temporary stay visa application is 30 days
tax_treatment: The visa pages read state no tax regime for this visa. The AT page on IFICI (successor to NHR) lists only specific qualifying activities and does not name remote work for a foreign employer (translated), so no automatic tax break is shown; general IRS residence rules apply
notes: Employees: work contract, promise of contract or employer declaration; independent: society contract, services contract/proposal or proof of services provided; plus proof of fiscal residence.

official_name: Long-stay visa for digital nomads
status_note: Listed on the MAE eVisa visa-types page checked 2026-09-28
min_income_basis: At least three times the average gross monthly salary in Romania for each of the last six months and the whole visa period (RON amount not stated on the page)
fee_text: Not stated on the page
processing_time: IGI (immigration inspectorate) page on temporary right of residence: application to grant/extend right of residence processed within 30 days of registration, extendable by 15 days where further checks are needed. General residence procedure, not stated specifically for digital nomads (search excerpt of igi.mai.gov.ro)
notes: Applicant must work remotely via ICT for a foreign-registered employer or own foreign-registered company.

official_name: Temporary residence permit for digital nomads
status_note: gov.si notice dated 2025-11-21 states the permit is available from 21 November 2025
min_income_basis: Funds must equal at least twice the average monthly net salary in Slovenia, calculated on the average monthly gross salary most recently published in the Official Gazette; any lawful income source accepted (gov.si). Slovenia.si (tourist board) says this is 'twice the average annual net salary ... about EUR 1,600' (wording ambiguous); no single euro figure on gov.si, so amount left null
fee_text: Fee not stated on the pages read
tax_treatment: (FURS guidance, Slovenian, read via automated summary, translated) Tax residents (registered permanent residence, habitual residence or centre of interests in Slovenia, or 183+ days in a tax year) are taxed on worldwide income; non-residents only on Slovenian-source income. Holders of the digital nomad permit are not automatically residents. Where no tax treaty exists with the employer's country there is no treaty relief. Social insurance registration is required depending on employment status
notes: Applicant must be a non-EU/EEA national working remotely for a business abroad or self-employed abroad, not entering the Slovenian labour market. Slovenia.si is the national tourist board portal; passport valid 3 months beyond stay per that page.

official_name: Remote Work Visa (visitor's visa category, effective 9 October 2024)
status_note: DHA notice PDF effective 9 Oct 2024 and DIRCO consulate page (Toronto) live when checked; DHA PDF text could not be extracted, so DHA-side details unverified
min_income_basis: Proof of sufficient financial means: gross salary of no less than the equivalent of R650 796 per annum, shown by three months bank statements
fee_text: Consulate in Toronto lists a fee of C$32 (money order/bank draft); fee varies by mission
tax_treatment: Holders from treaty countries must register with SARS if present over 183 days aggregate in 12 months; those from non-treaty countries must also register (per consulate page)
notes: Holder may not take up employment in South Africa (foreign employer/own foreign business only) and may not apply for change of status in the Republic except in exceptional circumstances. DHA PDF text was extracted with pdftotext on this check; it lists: application form, purpose/duration statement, return flight ticket or reservation, financial means, passport valid 30 days beyond departure, yellow fever certificate where applicable, contract of employment signed by both applicant and foreign employer, and proof of fee payment. It does not mention dependants, insurance, police clearance, processing time or a fee amount.

official_name: Workation (Digital Nomad) Visa F-1-D
status_note: Korean consulate pages (Seattle, notice dated Jan 2026) list F-1-D as available
min_income_basis: COMPUTED. Must earn more than twice the previous year GNI per capita, after tax, as announced by the Bank of Korea. Seattle consulate: current GNI per capita is 52.42 million won, so twice is about 104.84 million won, which the same page gives as approx. USD 75,400 a year. The Los Angeles consulate notice (dated 1 Jan 2026) instead states an annual salary of at least USD 66,000, so consulate pages disagree on the figure
fee_text: Seattle consulate lists USD 45 for US citizens; varies by nationality, no general figure verified
processing_time: 3-4 weeks at the Seattle consulate, no expedite
notes: Main applicant 18+, employed by a foreign company 1+ year. No Korean employment or profit work. Read via WebFetch summary of one consulate page; official ministry (moj.go.kr / hikorea) unreachable.

official_name: Telework visa / authorisation for international teleworking (digital nomad), Law 28/2022
status_note: Consular pages (Washington, New York) describe applications as accepted, checked 2026-09-28
min_income_basis: 200% of monthly minimum wage (SMI 1,221 EUR in 2026) for the applicant alone, per Washington consulate page; plus 75% of SMI (916 EUR) for first family member and 25% (306 EUR) for each additional
fee_text: No Spain-wide amount: the consular visa fee varies by consulate and nationality (Washington, 1 Jan 2026: US citizens USD 190; UK USD 963; Canada USD 1,566; Australia USD 3,020; Ethiopia USD 546; Mauritania USD 282; all other nationalities USD 106). Guadalajara consulate: MXN 1,765 in cash at the appointment. A search excerpt of an official consulate page cites EUR 73.26 for the form 790-038 fee; not read on the page itself
processing_time: Legal decision period stated by the New York consulate is 10 days from the day after submission, may be extended
tax_treatment: Tax agency page describes the special regime for workers relocating to Spain: eligible new tax residents may opt to be taxed under non-resident income tax rules while remaining IRPF taxpayers, for the year of arrival and the five following years; election by form 149. A search excerpt of an official tax agency page says remote workers were added to the regime from 1 Jan 2023 (seen via search excerpt of official page; the fetched page did not name remote workers)
notes: Must work for companies outside Spain (max 20% of professional activity for a Spanish company if self-employed); needs degree or 3 years experience, 3 months seniority with company and company at least 1 year old. Income amounts follow 2026 SMI and change yearly.

official_name: Digital Nomad Visa (DNV)
status_note: Department of Immigration and Emigration category PDF live
min_income_basis: Minimum monthly income remittance USD 2,000 for main applicant; extra USD 500 monthly per dependant beyond 2
fee_text: USD 500 per year for main applicant, and same for spouse and each dependant
tax_treatment: Holder must comply with Sri Lankan tax obligations; tax registration proof required for extension
notes: Applicant 18+, business not registered in Sri Lanka, no local employment. Medical and security clearance required.

official_name: Digital nomad visitor visa
status_note: BOCA page updated 2026-08-07 describes the application process
min_income_basis: Age 30+: annual salary of at least US$40,000 in one of last two years; age 20-29: US$20,000; or proof of another country's digital nomad visa
fee_text: Refers to a separate consular fee schedule; non-refundable
processing_time: Processing time is around two weeks; extra time if documents need correction or further evaluation (Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in the Philippines)
notes: Only nationals of visa-exempt countries eligible. Requires remote work experience proof, description of intended activities, resume, contract. Interview possible.

official_name: Destination Thailand Visa (DTV)
status_note: Royal Thai Embassy pages checked list DTV Workcation category; the e-visa portal itself is a JavaScript app and could not be read
min_income_basis: No income threshold stated on pages read; a funds test applies instead (see savingsAlternative)
fee_text: Fee is set per embassy and non-refundable: GBP 300 (London), SGD 500 (Singapore); no single THB figure verified on a primary page
processing_time: Kuala Lumpur embassy: approx. 1 month or more, case by case; apply at least 30 working days before travel. Singapore: apply at least 21 working days before travel
notes: Categories: Workcation (digital nomad/remote worker/foreign talent/freelancer), Thai soft power activities, and dependants. Remote workers show employment contract/portfolio (London). Fee and accepted bank accounts vary by embassy.

official_name: LTR Visa - Work-from-Thailand Professional
status_note: BOI LTR site lists the category; document checklist dated 30 June 2025 read
min_income_basis: Average personal income of USD 80,000/year over the past 2 years (per BOI search-result summary of ltr.boi.go.th; lower band USD 40,000-80,000 needs additional documents)
fee_text: 50,000 THB for the 10-year multiple-entry visa when collected in Thailand; when collected at a Royal Thai Embassy/Consulate or via e-visa the fee may vary and be considerably higher
processing_time: Qualification endorsement within 20 working days; pre-approval 1-3 working days; work permit 3-5 working days
tax_treatment: BOI LTR page states a 17% personal income tax rate for this category
notes: Employed by a foreign company; no Thai work permit granted under this category per BOI. Income figure read via search summary of the official site, not directly from page HTML.

official_name: Digital Nomad Visa / Digital Nomad Identification Certificate (GoTürkiye)
status_note: Official GoTürkiye platform describes the process; consular pages reference it
min_income_basis: Monthly income of USD 3,000 or USD 36,000 annually
fee_text: Non-refundable, set per consulate. Houston Consulate General 2026: single entry USD 60 (USD 185 for US citizens), multiple entry USD 180 (USD 265 for US citizens). Los Angeles Consulate General directs applicants to email for the fee
processing_time: Los Angeles Consulate General: processing after the interview may take up to 30 days; cannot be expedited. Houston advises applying at least one month (three in summer) before travel
notes: Ages 21-55, university degree, work contract with non-Turkish company; eligible nationalities listed (36 countries incl. US, UK, EU states).

official_name: Visa Issuance (Virtual Work) - Dubai GDRFA
status_note: GDRFA Dubai service page live

fee_text: AED 200 plus 5% VAT; additional AED 10 Knowledge, AED 10 Innovation and AED 500 inside-country fee if applicant is in the UAE
processing_time: Expected completion time 48 hours
notes: Dubai emirate only. Must work remotely for an entity outside the UAE; passport valid 6+ months. Abu Dhabi scheme not verified.
